results.title: Did US military create secret route through Hormuz? Report claims 10 million barrels of oil pass daily
results.description: Around 10 million barrels of oil per day, about half of the pre-war volume, are being shipped out of the strait into the global energy market through this low-profile corridor.

results.title: UAE suspends trade with Iran after coming under missile fire
